name: hero
facts: python3 is the only requirement — no renderer, no CLI, no network dependency
The committed .svg is both the asset and its own source; there is no render step between authoring and committing
The style catalog holds 32 named idioms, one resolved per repo
svg_check.py applies eight check classes to every visual: structural, seam, motion a11y, legibility, system, style, fidelity and size
Zero svg_check.py errors is required before a visual may be embedded
Animated visuals loop seam-exact at the declared data-loop-s
